verdict.rationale: The only evidence of API versioning is a /v1 prefix on a documented REST endpoint (POST /v1/search). The pack documents no deprecation policy, and the versioning of agents, suites and environments is product-data versioning rather than API versioning, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: a documented API versioning scheme, a deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, a changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
